ei.title: The Selective Nature of Individual Evolution
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — selective. This means that selection needs to be based on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms. It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival relative to other life forms. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.

A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①selective(형용사 보어) ②basing(←based 수동태) ③improves(동사) ④relative(형용사)
det.analysis:
① selective: needs to be selective → be 뒤 형용사 보어로 적절
② basing: 'selection needs to be based on' — be 동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사 based가 필요. basing(현재분사)은 틀림 ←정답
③ improves: a change improves the ability → 단수 주어에 3인칭 단수 동사 적절
④ relative: relative to other life forms → 전치사구 수식 형용사 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①produces(관계사절 동사) ②distributes(병렬 동사) ③nearby(부사) ④weather(←whether 접속사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①selectively(←selective 형용사 보어) ②not(부정) ③preferably(부사) ④expanding(병렬 동명사)
det.analysis:
① selectively: selection needs to be selective → be 동사의 보어 자리이므로 형용사 selective가 맞음. 부사 selectively는 보어 자리에 올 수 없음 ←정답
② not: not on a whole population → 부정 부사로 적절
③ preferably: given preferably to those people → 동사 수식 부사로 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①selective(선택적인) ②likelihood(가능성) ③suffers(고통받다←profits) ④preferably(우선적으로)
det.analysis:
① selective: 선택이 선택적이어야 진화가 작동 → 적절
② likelihood: 생존 가능성을 높여야 한다 → 적절
③ suffers: 유익한 돌연변이를 공유하면 주변 생명체가 '이득을 얻어야'(profits) 함. '고통받다'(suffers)는 맥락과 반대 ←정답
④ preferably: 더 잘 적응한 사람에게 우선적으로 부여 → 적절
det.tip: profits(이득을 얻다) ↔ suffers(고통받다)

It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival relative to other life forms. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that ②<u>slow down</u> the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the ③<u>beneficial</u> mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will ④<u>attract</u> more customers than a poorly run restaurant. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①individual(개별적인) ②slow down(늦추다←speed up) ③beneficial(유익한) ④attract(끌어들이다)
det.analysis:
① individual: 개체의 특성에 기반해야 한다 → 적절
② slow down: 돌연변이가 번식 과정을 '가속'(speed up)해야 한다. '늦추다'(slow down)는 맥락상 반대 ←정답
③ beneficial: 유익한 돌연변이를 갖지 않아도 이득 → 적절
④ attract: 더 좋은 레스토랑이 더 많은 고객을 끌어들인다 → 적절
det.tip: speed up(가속하다) ↔ slow down(늦추다)

questions.passage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — ①<u>selective</u>. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not.
